label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: deciding source logs PARTIAL; durable backlog peak 221

report.summary: Outbox publications lagged arrivals for most of the window and then caught up, but no source shows why. Metrics, pool, blockers and delivery logs are unavailable or empty.

findings.claim: Publications ran well below arrivals for most of the window, leaving a backlog of 125 events, then jumped to 71 and 81 per bucket in the last two buckets.
findings.reason: Arrivals were a steady 28 per 10 s bucket. Publications were 8-10 per bucket in buckets 2-13, then 71 and 81 in the final two.

findings.claim: The publication rate of about 10 per 10 s is consistent with a throttled poller, but the cause is not shown.
findings.reason: Config is batch 20 at a 1 s poll interval and a 3 s delivery timeout, so slow or failing deliveries could limit throughput. No delivery data confirms this.

limitations: Prometheus was unreachable, so request, pool and outbox gauge data are missing (E1, E2, E5).
The delivery log collector had not confirmed reading past the window end, so there are 0 attempt records (E3, E4). Blocker sampling had no successful samples (E6).
E1 (get_request_metrics) is UNAVAILABLE: Prometheus could not be queried, so request metrics are unknown.
